decision.rationale: TXN-008118 is a 45.76 EUR charge (4576 minor units) on card CRD-000190 from Kestrel Athletic Club (MER-000027), which bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-08-27 and posted on 2026-08-28. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 55 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone and has nothing in writing. No documents are attached and no merchant cancellation confirmation exists, so there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the merchant must provide its cancellation records and the subscription terms.

proposed_actions.note: For the subscription charge of 45.76 EUR made on 2026-08-27, please provide your cancellation records for this card's subscription, including any cancellation request received by phone and when it took effect, and the cancellation terms that applied to the subscription.
